name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: End-to-end AI discoverability and on-site engagement audit for enterprise websites. Evaluates crawlability, source selection, extractability, entity resolution, and non-text accessibility.
author: Adobe Hackathon 2026 — Round 3 Team

skills.description: Audits robots.txt permissions, link graph discoverability, and HTTP retrieval success.
Evaluates content density, heading-answer locality, and quote feasibility for RAG systems.
Tests render-dependent content loss, structured data availability, and fact-label associations.
Validates JSON-LD entity identity, sameAs link integrity, and cross-modal name consistency.
Checks image alt text, video transcript availability, and PDF text extractability.
